THE BIG STORY
Who pays for jet fuel

lines.text: United's fuel cost jumped about 60%. Guess who's covering the bill.
lines.say: United's fuel cost jumped about sixty percent. Guess who's covering the bill.

lines.text: United Airlines reported its third-quarter results on Tuesday, October 20.
lines.say: United Airlines reported its third-quarter results on Tuesday, October twentieth.

lines.text: It paid an average of $3.90 a gallon, up from $2.43 a year earlier.
lines.say: It paid an average of three dollars and ninety cents a gallon, up from two dollars and forty-three cents a year earlier.

lines.text: Its total fuel bill hit $4.84 billion for the quarter, up about 62%, CNBC reports.
lines.say: Its total fuel bill hit four point eight four billion dollars for the quarter, up about sixty-two percent, C N B C reports.

lines.text: United says it recovered about 72% of that extra fuel cost through higher revenue.
lines.say: United says it won back about seventy-two percent of that extra fuel cost through higher revenue.

lines.text: And it wants that number closer to 100%.
lines.say: And it wants that number closer to one hundred percent.

lines.text: Revenue still rose 17.4% to $17.9 billion, but United cut its full-year profit forecast.
lines.say: Revenue still rose seventeen point four percent to seventeen point nine billion dollars, but United cut its full-year profit forecast.

lines.text: And United expects $4.80 a gallon from October through December.
lines.say: And United expects four dollars and eighty cents a gallon from October through December.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.ig:
United's fuel cost jumped about 60%. Guess who's covering the bill.
United Airlines paid $3.90 a gallon in Q3 2026, up from $2.43 a year earlier; its fuel bill hit $4.84 billion.
United says it recovered about 72% of the extra fuel cost through higher revenue and wants that closer to 100%.
Revenue rose 17.4% to $17.9 billion, but United cut its 2026 profit forecast and expects $4.80 a gallon in Q4.
Sources: United Airlines Q3 2026 results (Oct 20, 2026), CNBC, Reuters.
News and education, not financial advice.
